payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear comparison between single-system and system combination approaches, highlighting the performance metrics and improvements achieved by the single-system method.

claims.text: The single-system approach achieved a word error rate (WER) of 41.6% on the DEV set and 43.2% on the EVAL set, which is a significant improvement over previous results without system combination.
The single-system performance is better than the previously published top-line results of 45.1% and 47.3% WER on DEV and EVAL, respectively, using a larger training dataset.
